newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares up at noon on good sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares up at noon on good sentiment.

text.p: Shanghai B shares were up at midday on Wednesday on positive sentiment, helped by good 1996 results from several companies and a year-high close for the B share index on Tuesday, brokers said.
The B index gained 0.941 points or 1.26 percent to 75.836 on volume of 9.38 million shares worth $5.07 million, compared with $3.2 million on Tuesday.
Brokers said they expected the index to rise further in the afternoon session with signs of volumes growing during the morning.
"The B share index hit a year-high level on Tuesday, which encourged more investors to build new positions today," one broker said.
"The market will see further gains in the short term given the good market sentiment, but it is likely to meet resistance at around 78 to 80 points," another broker said.
Of 43 B shares, 40 traded with 20 up, eight flat and 12 down.
Huangshan Tourism Development was the star and the most actively traded stock on institutional buying, jumping $0.044 or 7.00 percent to $0.672 on volume of 859,000 shares.
Shanghai Dazhong Taxi followed on talk of financial restructuring, up $0.082 or 6.50 percent to $1.342 on volume of 351,200 shares.
The Shanghai A share index was firmer on active buying, but the market was expected to go through a technical correction in the short term, brokers said.
The index put on 8.308 points or 0.60 percent to 1,398.060 points on volume of 406.5 million shares worth 5.1 billion yuan.
The SSE30 index edged up 17.416 points or 0.48 percent to 3,613.812 points.
Xiamen Titan Stock was the star on talk of a a good bonus offer plan, surging 1.31 yuan or 8.01 percent to 17.66 yuan on volume of 1.0 million shares.
